description: On the table there’s an open coloring book with a fish drawing and a box of Crayola crayons nearby. The right hand reaches toward the crayon box, pinches and lifts out a light green crayon, then moves down to the page and colors inside the fish with short back-and-forth strokes while the left hand rests on the paper to steady it; the right hand then pauses and slightly lifts the crayon away.
